# Aaron Lin - Engineering Portfolio

> Aaron Lin is a Boston University mechanical engineering student with an aerospace concentration, seeking Summer 2027 internships in mechanical design, aerospace, or product development. Expected graduation: May 2028.

This portfolio is Aaron's first-party account of his engineering experience and project work. It includes CAD, analysis, fabrication, integration, and test evidence. Project pages distinguish individual contributions from team outcomes and state analysis assumptions and limitations. ARGO and the ME360 Cartesian fishing game are in progress; their current milestones are not completed project outcomes.

## Candidate background

- [About Aaron]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Introduction, internship interests, selected projects, and technical skills.
- [Experience]({{ '/cv/' | absolute_url }}): Education, Culturon mechanical engineering internship, Boston University Rocket Propulsion Group work, and skills.
- [Resume (PDF)]({{ '/files/Aaron_Lin_resume_2026.pdf' | absolute_url }}): Downloadable resume.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Professional email and LinkedIn profile.

## Engineering evidence

- [Project index]({{ '/projects/' | absolute_url }}): Current and completed work with links to detailed case studies.
- [Rocket nozzle]({{ '/projects/rocket-nozzle/' | absolute_url }}): Completed resin nozzle design and fabrication, pressure-loading analysis, and static-fire integration work.
- [The Deskinator]({{ '/projects/ek210-deskinator/' | absolute_url }}): Completed team cleaning robot; Aaron's Arduino navigation firmware and assembly contributions, with a documented final trial collecting 72 of 95 rice grains.
- [ARGO aerodynamic fairing]({{ '/projects/argo-fairing/' | absolute_url }}): In-progress aerodynamic concept comparison using ANSYS Fluent and OpenRocket.
- [ME360 Cartesian fishing game]({{ '/projects/me360/' | absolute_url }}): Aaron leads CAD and mechanical layout for an in-progress joystick-controlled fishing mechanism. The team's preliminary pen-plotter rig completed square and circle path tests; joystick control and the final constrained-Z mechanism remain in development.
- [Engineering brief (PDF)]({{ '/files/Aaron_Lin_engineering_portfolio.pdf' | absolute_url }}): Selected project summaries and engineering artifacts.
